analysis:
Only docs/provider/cli-reference.md changed (head lines 17-60 and 1716). I saw the BASE text of lines 848-1738 and a truncated patch excerpt, so most of the head additions and the line-1716 change were not visible. This is documentation only; no source or control changes were supplied.

The visible patch adds a 'Local GLM qualification' section. It describes an experimental, local-only GLM root, opted into through DARKBLOOM_EXPERIMENTAL_GLM5_NEXT. That variable must name an absolute qualification JSON file, and unset, empty, '1' or malformed values, or mismatched identities, refuse GLM. The text says the variable is not forwarded into launchd, so network and coordinator serving is not enabled. It also says the opt-in does not bypass memory admission or qualify the model, and that GLM is always paged with embedded MTP.

The patch states that the encrypted checkpoint identity records the GLM execution policy. That bears on T-041 (prefix-cache and at-rest artifacts, A-001) and TB-007. It cannot be checked from the supplied evidence: the excerpt cuts off mid-sentence, and the GLM loader, the qualification file parsing and the cache-identity code are not supplied.

The base-side documented controls (env passthrough list, DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE defaults, App Attest worker opt-in, logout and report behavior) are pre-existing and unchanged in the visible text. No concrete regression is supported.

The next pass should read the full head patch, especially line 1716 and the truncated text after the GLM checkpoint-identity sentence. It should confirm that no claim widens network eligibility or weakens the T-041 cache-scope and TTL statements. It should also confirm that the documented 'not forwarded to launchd' claim matches LaunchAgent.passthroughEnvKeys; that code is not supplied here.
